headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with a pair of home runs and six RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Seattle Mariners placed shortstop Colt Emerson on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox also placed right-hander Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants transferred third baseman Matt Chapman from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

There were several notable roster moves and trades. The Boston Red Sox traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles. The Miami Marlins traded first baseman Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, handing the Cardinals their loss. Seiya Suzuki had a notable performance for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Colt Emerson on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners shortstop Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left wrist tendon inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
